import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for s in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=s, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {s} shape={df.shape} ---")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60, max_cols=30))

import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")
xml = z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")
print(xml)

import shutil
import re

expenses = [1500, 200, 150, 350, 150, 100, 500, 200, 50, 100, 500, 400]
print("Expense items:", expenses)
print("Total expenses:", sum(expenses))

# Parse the SUM(C11:C22) formula range from the XML and confirm it covers rows 11-22
xml = open("budget.xlsx", "rb").read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
m = re.search(r'<c r="C23"[^>]*><f>SUM\(C11:C22\)</f>', xml)

import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xl = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
grand_total = 0.0
for name in xl.sheet_names:
    df = xl.parse(name)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
    print(df.to_string(index=False))
    for col in df.columns:
        key = str(col).lower()
        if any(k in key for k in ('expense', 'amount', 'cost', 'spend')):
            s = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
            if s.notna().any():
                grand_total += s.sum()
print(f"\nTOTAL EXPENSES ACROSS ALL CATEGORIES: {grand_total}")
